headline: R R Kabel Limited: Acquisition
sum: Acquisition - RRKABEL: R R Kabel Limited has informed the Exchange about the execution of the Business Transfer Agreement for purchase and acquisition of the Business Undertaking of U M Cables Limited by the Company.
